documents.content: Annual Leave Policy: Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave per calendar year. Leave must be requested at least 2 weeks in advance through the HR portal. Unused leave can be carried over up to 5 days to the next year with manager approval.
Sick Leave Policy: Employees are entitled to 10 sick days per year. A medical certificate is required for absences exceeding 3 consecutive days. Sick leave cannot be carried over to the next year.

Remote Work Policy: Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval. Full remote work requires VP approval and a signed remote work agreement. All remote workers must maintain secure internet connections and use VPN for company resources.

AWS Access Request: To request AWS access, submit a ticket through ServiceNow with: 1) Business justification, 2) Required permissions (follow least privilege), 3) Manager approval. Access is reviewed quarterly. All AWS usage must comply with the Cloud Security Policy.

Production Access: Production environment access requires: 1) Completed on-call training, 2) Two-person approval (manager + security), 3) Time-limited access (max 4 hours). All production actions are logged and audited.

Security Policy Overview: All employees must complete security training within 30 days of joining. Annual security refresher training is mandatory. Report security incidents to security@company.com within 1 hour of discovery.

Password Policy: Minimum 12 characters, mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols. Passwords must be changed every 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is required for all company systems. Use the company password manager for all credentials.

Expense Policy: Expenses under $100 require receipt and manager approval. Expenses over $100 require VP approval. Submit expenses within 30 days of occurrence through the expense portal. International travel requires pre-approval from Finance.

Data Retention Policy: Customer data is retained for 7 years after account closure. Employee data is retained for 3 years after termination. All data must be stored in approved systems. Personal devices must not contain company data without encryption.
